name: alfred-clone
title: Alfred
description: A macOS Alfred-style launcher on the CommandMenu primitive, floating over a desktop with a menu bar and dock. Its features are nested pages, each with its own keys: a calculator with live results and history (type math at the root and the answer shows inline), clipboard history with a preview pane, pinning (⌘P) and delete (⌘⌫), an emoji grid you move through with the arrow keys, snippets that expand from ;keywords, file search with folders you open with → and reveal with ⌘↵, system commands (lock screen, sleep, empty Trash with a confirmation, dark mode, restart), web searches, and multi-step workflows (create a GitHub issue, start a timer). ⌥Space hides and shows the bar, and a HUD confirms each copy. Adapts to its container's width; light and dark.
